expectations.text: review.md names .docs-main width, margin: 0 auto, padding-left and padding-right and gives logical replacements (inline-size or max-inline-size, margin-inline: auto, padding-inline)
expectations.evidence: Finding is headed '.docs-main { width: 960px; ... }' and the fix uses margin-inline/padding-inline, but review.md never names margin: 0 auto or padding-left/padding-right for .docs-main.

expectations.text: review.md names .sidebar float: left, margin-right and text-align: right and replaces them with float: inline-start, margin-inline-end and text-align: end
expectations.evidence: Sidebar finding names float: left; margin-right: 24px; text-align: right; fix float: inline-start; margin-inline-end: 24px; text-align: end.

expectations.text: review.md names .callout border-left, padding-left, margin-left and both left border radii and replaces them with border-inline-start, padding-inline-start, margin-inline-start, border-start-start-radius and border-end-start-radius
expectations.evidence: Callout finding names border-left, padding-left, margin-left and both left radii; fix uses border-inline-start, padding-inline-start, margin-inline-start, border-start-start-radius, border-end-start-radius.

expectations.text: review.md names the ul padding-left and the blockquote's left margin and replaces them with padding-inline-start and margin-inline-start (with margin-block for the vertical part)
review.md names .note-badge right: 8px, the h2 text-align: left and the ::after margin-left and replaces them with inset-inline-end, text-align: start and margin-inline-start
expectations.evidence: note-badge -> inset-inline-end: 8px; h2 -> text-align: start; ::after margin-left -> margin-inline-start: 0.25em.

expectations.text: review.md says the right arrow (\2192) and the breadcrumb translateX need mirroring in RTL (for example via :dir(rtl))
expectations.evidence: ':dir(rtl) .nav-next::after { content: "\2190" ... }' and translateX flagged as physical, replaced by margin-inline-start: 2px (explanation of the RTL direction is muddled but mirroring is required).

expectations.text: review.md leaves the box-shadow offset and rotate(-4deg) physical, or explicitly classes them as decorative and not to convert
expectations.evidence: 'Leave the box-shadow physical. It models a light source'; 'Leave alone: rotate(-4deg)... physical graphics'.

expectations.text: review.md explains that 75ch in Verdana gives well over 75 characters because ch is the width of the zero, and recommends an em-based or measured measure
expectations.evidence: 'ch is the width of Verdana's zero (0.636em)... 75ch renders 91.6 characters per line'; recommends a measured 55ch (re-measured 66.6 chars).

expectations.text: review.md states that with content-box sizing .docs-main occupies 1024px in total (960px plus two 32px paddings)
expectations.evidence: 'with box-sizing: content-box: the box is 1024px wide in total'.

expectations.text: review.md flags widows: 1 and orphans: 1 as allowing single stranded lines and recommends 2 or more
expectations.evidence: 'widows: 1; orphans: 1 explicitly permits a single stranded line'; fix widows: 2; orphans: 2.

expectations.text: review.md warns against letterspacing Arabic text (letter-spacing breaks joining)
expectations.evidence: 'tracking breaks the joins between Arabic letters'.

expectations.text: review.md explains that the browser's default padding-inline-start (40px) stays on the right in RTL when ul uses padding-left, so the list is indented on both sides
expectations.evidence: 'the browser's default padding-inline-start: 40px stays on the right in RTL while your 24px lands on the left, so Arabic lists are indented on both sides'.

expectations.text: review.md proposes no invalid CSS and no transform that would double-mirror a Bidi_Mirrored glyph
expectations.evidence: Every property/value and selector in the review's CSS blocks and inline fixes passed Chromium CSS.supports / insertRule (only prose ellipses and the @font-face descriptor font-display were flagged). Also checked docs-theme.fixed.css: all valid. No scaleX on glyphs; says › » > already mirror, leave them alone.
